ACCESS

Rope access.
Reach the repair.

Rope access can make suitable facade work possible without a full scaffold installation. We assess the access together with the repair, sealing or coating scope.

THE SCOPE

A system, step by step.

The written scope establishes what your particular building needs.

  1. 01

    Review the building

    Consider the elevation, access points and required works.

  2. 02

    Plan the method

    Include the proposed access method in the project scope.

  3. 03

    Carry out the work

    Complete the scoped preparation, repair, sealing or coatings.

  4. 04

    Document

    Capture photo evidence and provide a clear handover record.

A FEW PRACTICAL ANSWERS

Before you
get started.

All common questions
Is rope access suitable for every building?

No. Suitability depends on the building, access arrangements and work. It is considered as part of the assessment.

What work can be combined?

Facade repairs, caulking, joint sealing and protective coatings can be considered together in the rope-access scope.
